page.notes: The left column runs down to "Accursio"; the right column continues from "Accusatoria Oratio" to the foot. Greek entries "Αγμὴ" and "Axυεgλογία" are as printed (the second is a garbled Greek word in the scan, transcribed as seen). The "(iii)" at the foot is a printed signature-like mark.
